first_impression.reaction: Typed 'santorini wedding venues' on the train. The first line gives me the four areas straight away, and the takeaways give me the guest numbers, so I already know the cliff-top places are small. There's a jump list too. I'd read the takeaways, glance at the table, tap Imerovigli or Oia, look at the weather bit, check the FAQ and bookmark it.

journey.quote: Santorini wedding venues with a caldera view sit in four parts of the island: Oia, Imerovigli, Pyrgos and the inland villages, and Akrotiri.
journey.reaction: Answer in the first sentence and it matches what I searched. Good.

journey.quote: Choose the area first, because Oia, Imerovigli, the inland wineries and Akrotiri each give a different view of the caldera and a different kind of day.
journey.reaction: Same four areas I just read in the intro. The takeaways are the bit I definitely read, so a repeat feels like a wasted bullet.

journey.quote: Most cliff-top ceremony spaces hold between 15 and 60 guests, so a larger guest list points to a full-property buyout, a winery terrace or the open-air space at Grand Ambassador in Akrotiri.
journey.reaction: This is the one I'd screenshot. Tells me in one line where to look if we're 100 people.

journey.section: Santorini wedding venues at a glance
journey.quote: | Venue | Area | Caldera view setting | Ceremony options | Largest published capacity |
journey.reaction: Five columns, so on my phone I'm swiping sideways to reach capacity, which is the column I actually want. Useful once I get there though.

journey.section: Santorini wedding venues at a glance
journey.quote: | Venetsanos Winery | Not published | Upper Terrace overlooking the caldera | Ceremony and reception on the Upper Terrace | 100 seated, 160 standing |
journey.reaction: Area says 'Not published', but later it sits under 'Pyrgos and the inland villages'. So where is it? Same with Le Ciel, area unknown but filed under 'Elsewhere on the caldera'.

journey.section: Choosing an area of the island
journey.quote: Choose Akrotiri when the guest list runs into the hundreds and you still want the caldera behind you.
journey.reaction: Love these 'choose X when' lines. Quick and decisive. Honestly I'd like them up in the takeaways.

journey.section: Choosing an area of the island
journey.quote: None of the 13 venues here is in Fira or Firostefani, but couples who want guests close to town can still marry nearby: Katikies Chromata is about a five-minute drive from Fira.
journey.reaction: Intro said four areas, now there's a fifth with nothing in it. Helpful answer for 'near town' though, so fine.

journey.quote: Up to 30 guests on the Panorama Balcony, 40 on the Sunday Veranda and 25 on the Epitome Sunset Terrace.
journey.reaction: Real numbers per space. But I've now seen these Canaves numbers in the table, the compare section and here, and they come back again in the FAQ.

journey.quote: A unity ceremony in which you combine black and white volcanic sand collected together from Santorini's beaches, 363 metres above sea level.
journey.reaction: Okay, that's lovely. That's the kind of detail that makes me bookmark.

journey.quote: Children above 13 are welcome, and younger children are pointed to the group's hotel in Fira.
journey.reaction: Real rule that rules a place in or out fast if cousins bring kids.

journey.quote: For guests with limited mobility, Le Ciel is the one venue here that publishes step-free access.
journey.reaction: Santorini is all stairs, everyone knows that. This is genuinely useful for my grandparents.

journey.quote: As at November 2026, [Smartraveller](https://www.smartraveller.gov.au/destinations/europe/greece) says heatwaves are frequent in Greece over the summer months, and advises water, light clothing and shade.
journey.reaction: Dated this month, so I know it's current.

journey.quote: Summer brings frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September, so weigh the heat against the rain.
journey.reaction: I asked 'when should we get married' and got 'weigh it up'. The section above has all the monthly temperatures, so just tell me which months look best.

journey.quote: Which Santorini venues can host 100 guests?
journey.reaction: Exactly the question I'd type. Straight answer with names.

journey.quote: Can Australians legally get married in Santorini?
journey.reaction: I'm in Singapore. The legal bit is all Australian paperwork, so it's not for me.

journey.section: Shortlist your Santorini venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
journey.reaction: So it's an Australian service. Not sure they'd take me.

unanswered_questions: Roughly what does a Santorini venue cost? Even a ballpark would help.
Which months are actually best for a wedding? The page gives temperatures but never names a month to aim for.
Where exactly are Venetsanos Winery and Le Ciel?
Does the Andronis wedding happen at the Oia hotel or somewhere else in the group?
Do you work with couples outside Australia?

turn_offs_found.quote: Summer brings frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September, so weigh the heat against the rain.
turn_offs_found.why: Both the 'When to marry' heading and the FAQ promise an answer and leave me with 'weigh it up'. I wanted a month or two to aim for, and the numbers to pick one are already on the page.

turn_offs_found.quote: Choose the area first, because Oia, Imerovigli, the inland wineries and Akrotiri each give a different view of the caldera and a different kind of day.
turn_offs_found.why: The first takeaway repeats the intro I just read. Takeaways are the one part I always read, so a repeat there wastes my attention.

turn_offs_found.quote: | Venue | Area | Caldera view setting | Ceremony options | Largest published capacity |
turn_offs_found.why: Too wide for a phone. I have to swipe sideways to reach capacity, and the caldera view column mostly says the same thing in each row, since every venue has a caldera view.

turn_offs_found.quote: Up to 30 guests on the Panorama Balcony, 40 on the Sunday Veranda and 25 on the Epitome Sunset Terrace.
turn_offs_found.why: The same Canaves numbers appear in the table, the compare section, the Oia section and the FAQ. Lots of scrolling to see the same three numbers.

would_share_with: A friend thinking about a Greek island wedding; I'd send the takeaways and the 'Choosing an area' paragraphs
My mum, for the step-free access line at Le Ciel and the children above 13 rule

cta_reaction.quote: shortlist your Santorini venues through Wedded Concierge
cta_reaction.why: I'm only browsing, not planning yet. The links sit inside the text, no pop-ups, so they didn't annoy me. I'd bookmark before I'd enquire, and the 'AUD for Australian couples' line makes me think it isn't for me.

top_3_changes: Make 'When to marry in Santorini' and its FAQ answer the question: name the month window the page's own temperature, rain and heat figures point to, instead of 'weigh the heat against the rain'.
Swap the first takeaway (a repeat of the intro) for the 'choose X when' area rules, and trim the repeated Canaves capacity numbers in the compare section and FAQ to a short pointer.

Make the at-a-glance table phone-friendly: drop or shorten the 'Caldera view setting' column so capacity is visible without a sideways swipe, and give Venetsanos and Le Ciel an area that matches the section they sit in, or file them together.

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Stayed in character as Priya, a casual Google searcher on a phone
No invented brand facts; missing info went to unanswered_questions
Journey types limited to gained_trust, lost_trust, confused, bored, excited, objection
Person-set title, deferred business details and deliberately unprinted prices not treated as must-fix; no request for sourcing or 'not published' explanations

assumptions: Persona is provisional (weight 0.10); reactions reflect generic informational search intent.

Arrived from a Google search for 'santorini wedding venues' on a phone, with a 5-minute budget; read the intro and takeaways, glanced at the table, the area section, Oia and Imerovigli venues, Le Ciel, the weather section, FAQ and closing.
Prices are deliberately not printed; the missing ballpark is logged as an unanswered question only.
The Australia-focused framing is logged as a low-severity objection, not a must-fix, since business focus is deferred.
The month-window change asks the copy to state what its existing figures show; no climate facts were invented.
Image slots and HTML comments treated as invisible; quotes with link markup are given as written in the draft.
